description: Finds GRAINS inside the zone [stt, end] of the source and extends the sound by 'plus' seconds of additional grain material, leaving everything outside the zone in place - iterative extension driven by the sound's own grain grid rather than a fixed segment. Grain detection is windowed (wsiz ms) with troughs accepted below 'trof' relative to adjacent peaks. DURATION: nominally indur + plus - EXACT on speech-like material (a 3.5 s syllable train rendered 5.4998 and 4.4999 at plus 2.0/1.0) but source-dependent on dense grain trains (a 16-grain 2 s train rendered 5.2622 at plus 1.5 - +1.76 s beyond the model; the added material rounds to the found grain grid). The model is honest for sparse/speech grains; budget overshoot elsewhere and measure. CONTENT REFUSAL: material where no grains are found refuses 'INFO: Number of grains found = 0' then 'ERROR: INVALID DATA / ERROR: Insufficient grains to proceed.' (a single sustained event, a reversed zone, trof at either extreme 0/1, or plus 0 all landed there on probes). ALL FIVE parameters refuse breakpoint files verbatim ('Cannot read parameter 1..5 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.' - each slot probed): fully scalar. Deterministic (pairs 1.3 s apart byte-identical; no seed, no randomness observed). MONO ONLY ('File ev4st.wav is not of correct type (must be mono)'). Ranges verbatim: wsiz '(0.181406 to 666.666667)' ms (srate-dependent); end 0 to input duration; plus '(0.000002 to 3600.000000)'.
musical_use: Stretch the grainy part, keep the rest: where a time-stretch smears attacks and a freeze loops one chunk, grainex prolongs a rolled R, a rattle, a bubbling texture, a tremolo - any grain train - by recycling its own grains, with the material before and after untouched. Point stt/end at the grainy stretch, set wsiz near the grain period (20-50 ms for speech-rate grains; the found-grain count prints to the console), trof ~0.3-0.5, and 'plus' to the extra seconds wanted. Great for speech elongation ('rrrr' held for drama), extending percussion rolls, or making a texture linger before its release. Sources must actually be grainy - steady tones and smooth pads refuse (verbatim error). For pitch-synchronous grain work use psow; for arbitrary-segment freezing use extend freeze.

wsiz.description: Window size in ms - sets the scale of grains to find (CDP-enforced '(0.181406 to 666.666667)', srate-dependent; 0 refused verbatim). Match it to the grain period of the material. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 1').

trof.description: Acceptable trough height relative to adjacent peaks, exclusive range (0,1): both 0 and 1 ran into 'Insufficient grains to proceed.' on probes - keep it strictly inside; 0.3 found grains where 0.9 also did (identical render on that fixture - detector saturates). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 2').

plus.description: How much duration to add (CDP-enforced '(0.000002 to 3600.000000)', -1 refused verbatim; plus 0 lands in the insufficient-grains refusal - always pass a positive value). Added material rounds to the found grain grid: exact on speech-like grains, up to +1.8 s beyond on a dense 16-grain train (see known_issues). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 3').

stt.description: Start of the grain zone within the source. A reversed zone (stt > end) fails with the insufficient-grains refusal, not a range error. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 4').

end.description: End of the grain zone; CDP-enforced ceiling = input duration ('Parameter[5] Value (2.500000) out of range (0.000000 to 2.000000)', input-dependent). Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 5').

examples.description: Hold a rolled consonant two seconds longer.
examples.expected_use: On a syllable train this rendered exactly indur + 2.0 (5.4998 from 3.5 s). Console prints the found-grain count.

examples.description: Let a rattle linger before its decay.
examples.expected_use: Grain zone extended by ~1 s (grid-rounded); material outside 0.2-0.9 s untouched.

known_issues: Duration honesty: indur + plus was EXACT (4 dp) at two plus values on a 3.5 s syllable train, but a dense 16-grain train rendered +1.71/+1.76 s BEYOND the model at plus 0.5/1.5 - the extension rounds to whole passes of the found grain grid. Treat the model as a floor on unfamiliar material and measure. duration_row null: the flat-noise fixture's grain census is unverified and the overshoot is content-dependent (rule pinned in docs/curation/tranche15_gesture.md).

CONTENT REFUSAL is the common failure: 'Insufficient grains to proceed.' (verbatim, after 'Number of grains found = 0') on sustained/smooth material, trof at 0 or 1, plus 0, or a reversed zone. Choose grainy zones and interior trof values.
All five parameters are scalar-only (each brk slot refused verbatim, parameters 1-5).
MONO ONLY (verbatim). Deterministic - byte-identical pairs, no seed.
wsiz bounds are srate-dependent (0.18-666.67 ms at 44.1 kHz, verbatim).
